stories-41-9-12-earth-in-two-days-susten.title: Earth Created Before the Heavens and Seven Heavens Formed from Smoke
stories-41-9-12-earth-in-two-days-susten.note: Surah 41:9–12 places the earth's creation and mountains before the fashioning of seven heavens from smoke, matching Beit Hillel's earth-first order in Talmud Chagigah 12a and the seven firmaments of Chagigah 12b.

discussion.view: Al-Tabari and Ibn Kathir harmonize the sequence in 41:9–12 with 79:27–30 by distinguishing the initial creation of the unformed earth before the seven heavens from the later spreading out (daha) of the terrestrial surface after the sky was completed.
discussion.reply: Genesis 1:1–8 places the firmament of heaven on the second day before dry land and plants appear on the third day. In Talmud Bavli Chagigah 12a–12b, Beit Hillel argues that the earth was created before the heavens, and Reish Lakish enumerates seven distinct firmaments by name, providing the rabbinic cosmology echoed in 41:9–12.

stories-41-9-12-earth-in-two-days-susten.quranEn: [9] Say: ‘Do you indeed disbelieve in the One who created the earth in two days, and do you set up rivals to Him? That is the Lord of the worlds. [10] He placed on it firm mountains (towering) above it, and blessed it, and decreed for it its (various) foods in four days, equal to the ones who ask. [11] Then He mounted (upward) to the sky, while it was (still) smoke, and said to it and to the earth, “Come, both of you, willingly or unwillingly!” They both said, “We come willingly.” [12] He finished them (as) seven heavens in two days, and inspired each heaven (with) its affair. And We adorned the sky of this world with lamps, and (made them) a protection. That is the decree of the Mighty, the Knowing.’

sources.title: Talmud Bavli Chagigah 12a (Rabbinic Debate on the Order of Creation of Heaven and Earth)
sources.workSub: Talmud Bavli Chagigah 12a (Rabbinic Debate on the Order of Creation of Heaven and Earth)
sources.en: Beit Shammai and Beit Hillel dispute the order of Creation, as the Sages taught: Beit Shammai say: The heavens were created first and afterward the earth was created, as it is stated: “In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth” (Genesis 1:1), which indicates that heaven came first. And Beit Hillel say: The earth was created first, and heaven after it, as it is stated: “On the day that the Lord God made earth and heaven” (Genesis 2:4).
highlights: Beit Shammai and Beit Hillel dispute the order of Creation
And Beit Hillel say: The earth was created first, and heaven after it
sources.orig: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן, בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹמְרִים: שָׁמַיִם נִבְרְאוּ תְּחִלָּה וְאַחַר כָּךְ נִבְרֵאת הָאָרֶץ, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים אֵת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֵת הָאָרֶץ״. וּבֵית הִלֵּל אוֹמְרִים: אֶרֶץ נִבְרֵאת תְּחִלָּה וְאַחַר כָּךְ שָׁמַיִם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״בְּיוֹם עֲשׂוֹת ה׳ אֱלֹהִים אֶרֶץ וְשָׁמָיִם״.

sources.orig: רֵישׁ לָקִישׁ אָמַר: שִׁבְעָה, וְאֵלּוּ הֵן: וִילוֹן, רָקִיעַ, שְׁחָקִים, זְבוּל, מָעוֹן, מָכוֹן, עֲרָבוֹת. וִילוֹן — אֵינוֹ מְשַׁמֵּשׁ כְּלוּם, אֶלָּא נִכְנָס שַׁחֲרִית וְיוֹצֵא עַרְבִית, וּמְחַדֵּשׁ בְּכׇל יוֹם מַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״הַנּוֹטֶה כַדּוֹק שָׁמַיִם וַיִּמְתָּחֵם כָּאֹהֶל לָשָׁבֶת״. רָקִיעַ — שֶׁבּוֹ חַמָּה וּלְבָנָה כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת קְבוּעִין, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וַיִּתֵּן אוֹתָם אֱלֹהִים בִּרְקִיעַ הַשָּׁמָיִם״.
